purpose: Delete predictable low-value PDF materialization work for narrowly defined administrative meeting notices while preserving conservative AI-Core semantics.

triage_states.MATERIALIZE_CANDIDATE: Candidate remains eligible for official PDF materialization and classifier processing.
triage_states.SKIP_LOW_INFORMATION_ADMIN_NOTICE: Do not materialize this candidate in the routine E-layer pipeline; this is a cost-control state only and has no eligibility meaning.

narrow_skip_rule.scope: Administrative announcements whose title only announces attendance at, or convening of, a performance-results briefing/collective performance-results briefing.
examples: 关于参加科创板2026年半年度人工智能行业集体业绩说明会的公告
关于召开2026年半年度业绩说明会的公告
regex_intent: 关于参加.*业绩说明会.*公告
关于召开.*业绩说明会.*公告

explicitly_not_suppressed_by_this_versio: 年度报告 or 半年度报告
合同/订单/产品/业务进展公告
投资者关系活动记录表
任何未命中窄规则的文档
